unit.why: A narrative about a penitent sent by R. Mordechai of Chernobyl to R. Israel of Ruzhin, who prescribes a regimen of repentance; the penitent's later elevation is reported by the Ruzhiner's son, the rebbe of Chortkov.

stories.start_quote: שבעל תשובה אחד בא מקודם לפני
stories.end_quote: תשובה על כל דבר ודבר. ודפח"ח
stories.summary_en: A grave sinner brings a kvittel listing his sins to R. Mordechai of Chernobyl, who sends him to the young Ruzhiner. The Ruzhiner prescribes saying every holy utterance only from a siddur and gazing at his face at the table, and the man later becomes a man of high spiritual rank who receives kvitlech, as the Chortkover recounts.

tags.why: The whole story concerns the penitent's teshuvah.
